title: Priority dependency synthesis and fallthrough policies for roadmap cycles
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a single source of truth and decision policy for prioritizing and resolving roadmap dependencies across Eng, Design, Security, and Infra for the 2026-Q2 cycle. Deliverables: dependency index (status/owner/ETA), escalation rules, automated fallthroughs for low-risk features, and a lightweight dashboard feed for PM/Eng leads.
acceptance_criteria: A dependency index CSV exported and stored in Confluence with columns: key, owner, team, blocking_feature, risk_level, ETA, mitigation_plan
Documented fallthrough policy: auto-fallback models/variants or capacity banding when Dedicated capacity is constrained
Escalation path defined and agreed with heads of Eng, Design, Security, Infra (contacts + SLAs)
Automated Slack alerts for dependencies entering 'At Risk' state with a recommended action (page on P0, notify on P1)
One demo to PM/Eng/Design reviewers showing dashboard feed and example mitigations for two simulated blockers
